members.reason: ["The 86 machine clauses include many self-executing effective-date and redesignation commands (section 1, effective 1979-01-01 under section 2-404) and amendments and revocations of roughly one hundred other orders (section 2-1, 2-2, 2-3). Whether each clause was exhausted by performance, ended with the order it amended, or continues cannot be decided from the packet, which holds no text of the amended orders as they stood after 1979 and no consolidated current text of EO 12107; the 5 U.S.C. 1101 note extract (CURRENT:EO:12107#0) holds only the status line (amended by EO 12126 and 12128) and the preamble.","The dossier carries an unresolved conflict, PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER: a later revocation dated 2018-06-15 of part of the order with scope not stated and no actor named; no instrument of that date is held in the packet's later-event evidence. Its identity, text and scope are needed before any clause can be called operative or terminated.","Six amending or correcting instruments are attached (EO 12126, 12128, 12163, 12353, 12363, 12379) and two later orders reciting it (EO 13467, 13764); each needs a clause-level reading against the 86 clauses, and the first end or current predicate of the Civil Service Rules and personnel-order amendments in section 2-103 onward needs the current text of the Civil Service Rules and of the amended orders, which are not held."]

["No held source shows the date the Neutrality Treaty entered into force or the date of the Corozal Cemetery agreement with Panama, so the first end of sections 1-101, 1-103, 1-106(b), 1-107 and 1-108 (each tied to entry into force or performed once) cannot be dated from held evidence.","No held source shows performance of the disinterment, reinterment, notice and transport commands in sections 1-103, 1-104, 1-105 and 1-106, or the abolition of the Governor of the Canal Zone and Canal Zone offices that the order names; the April 1, 1982 date in 1-104 and 1-106(c) is a request deadline, not an end.","Needed: held text of the Panama Canal treaties' entry-into-force instrument (1979-10-01), the Panama Canal Act of 1979 provisions abolishing the Canal Zone offices, and the ABMC/Corozal agreement or ABMC record showing section 1-102 continues; the 36 U.S.C. 2111 note (CURRENT:EO:12115#0) prints the order without an ending statement but cannot date any spent clause."]

["Later amendments are not citable from this packet: EO 13124 (64 FR 31103, June 4, 1999, psychiatric-disability amendment of Civil Service Rule 3.1(b), cited in the held 5 CFR part 213 text as amending EO 12125) is held in jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_13124.txt but is not among the packet's later-event evidence ids, and the packet's later-events search found no edge to it; the claim would omit a held amendment. A source supplement adding EO 13124 (and EO 14410, 91 FR 34893, June 10, 2026, and 65 FR 41868, July 7, 2000, named in the 5 CFR 3.1 history line) is needed.","The packet holds no CURRENT: record for this order; the continuing predicate would rest on 5 CFR 3.1(b) as added by the order and later amended, which needs the later-event texts above attached before it can be claimed."]

["Held evidence dates only part of the order: section 1-2 (Peace Corps Advisory Council, clauses 1-201 to 1-208) was revoked by EO 12399 section 4(k), effective 1982-12-31 under its section 6; section 1-301(e) was deleted by EO 13724 section 1(b) (signed 2016-04-08) and a new section 1-113 added; EO 12245 (1980-10-06) and EO 12292 (effective 1981-02-15) amended 1-202, 1-111 and 1-401.","The state on 2026-10-14 of the remaining 36 clauses (sections 1-101 to 1-112, 1-301 and (a)-(d), 1-401, 1-403, 1-501, 1-601 and (a)-(d), 1-602 to 1-605, 1-701 to 1-707) cannot be decided from the packet: they are framed around the Peace Corps as an agency within ACTION and the Director of ACTION (1-101, 1-102, 1-501, 1-601 to 1-605) and around one-time transfers and supersessions (1-703 to 1-706), and the packet holds no text showing whether and when the Peace Corps ceased to be an agency within ACTION or ACTION's functions were transferred or ended (the statutes involved are not held), no text of the current Peace Corps Act (22 U.S.C. 2501-2523) as in force on 2026-10-14, and no text showing performance of the 1-703 to 1-706 transfers. The 22 U.S.C. 2501 note extract (CURRENT:EO:12137#0) holds only the status line and preamble, not the sections.","Needed: held text of the statutes or reorganization instruments that changed the status of the Peace Corps within ACTION and that abolished or transferred ACTION; the sections of the order as printed in the 22 U.S.C. 2501 note; and the order's transfer records for 1-703 to 1-706."]

["The state on 2026-10-14 of each position placement in sections 1-101(a)-(h) and 1-102(a)-(d) cannot be decided from the packet. Fifteen amending orders are held (EO 12199, 12236, 12237, 12422, 12431, 12608, 12678, 12679, 12749, 12758, 12814, 12833, 12841, 12942, 13063) and they add, delete and reletter subsections (for example EO 12199 replaces 1-101(e); EO 12841 moves the Commissioner on Aging from 1-102(d) to a new 1-101(k) and relettering follows; EO 13063 removes the Executive Director of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation from 1-102(b)), but the packet holds no text of the Executive Schedule as in force on 2026-10-14 (5 U.S.C. 5315-5317) and no text showing which of the placed positions (for example the Council on Wage and Price Stability deputy advisers, the Alcohol, Drug Abuse and Mental Health Administration, or the Special Assistant to the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations) still exist or whether a statute removed or replaced a placement.","The 5 U.S.C. 5317 note extract (CURRENT:EO:12154#0) holds only the status line (amended through EO 13063) and the preamble, not the placement lists. Needed: the 5 U.S.C. 5317 note text with the current lists, or 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 and the statutes abolishing or renaming each placed position, so that each of the 14 placement clauses can be assigned a state and a dated end or a current predicate."]

["The 120 machine clauses are subject to a long amendment and partial-revocation history that the packet cannot reduce to a per-clause state: about twenty later orders are attached (EO 12226, 12292, 12321, 12365, 12423, 12458, 12500, 12560, 12608, 12620, 12639, 12680, 12695, 12738, 13030 and others named in the U.S. Code status line), EO 12292 section 8(a) revokes 1-201(a)(14), EO 12608 section 30 revokes 1-201(a)(23) and (24) and renumbers, and EO 13118 (1999-03-31) revokes Part 1-4; the later-events catalog also records a Presidential determination (91-20) and EO 12884 as cross-references. Each needs a clause-level reading and a dated first end for every revoked or struck paragraph.","The packet holds no consolidated current text of EO 12163 (the 22 U.S.C. 2381 note extract, CURRENT:EO:12163#0, holds only the status line and preamble) and no text of the foreign-assistance statutes it implements as in force on 2026-10-14 (the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 and related statutes whose functions the order delegates), so the continuing predicate of the delegations after later reorganizations of the foreign-affairs agencies cannot be checked. The Presidential determination 91-20 is not an order with held text."]
